units: Targ. Ps. XIX, 5 מתח עִנְיָנְהוֹן (ed. Lag. עִנְיָנֵיהוֹן, pl.) the extension of their purpose.—

<cite ref="Nedarim 51a:4">Ned. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>אמר ליה כי ע׳ קדמאה</he> he said to him something similar to the first proposition (‘let thy wife offer me a measure of wine’); <he>עיביד כי ע׳ קדמאה</he> do according to the first proposition.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 9a:2">B. Bath. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>עבדי ע׳ בהדי הדדי וכ׳</he> made an arrangement between themselves that &c.
Ib. 114ᵃ sq. דיסליקו מע׳ לע׳ they turned from one affair to another; a. fr.—Pl. עִנְיָנִין, עִנְיָי׳, עִי׳.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:11">Targ. Cant. I, 11</cite> <he>סכום ע׳ וכ׳</he> the sum of their various interpretations is forty-nine.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 41:2">Targ. Ps. XLI, 2</cite> <he>לעִנְיָינֵי מסכנא</he> Ms. (ed. <he>לעניי</he>, corr. acc.) to the affairs (needs) of the poor (cmp.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:11">Lev. R. s. 34</cite>, quot. s. v. <cite ref="G00443"><he>זָכָה</he></cite>).
